{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.58

|gr1= GUI

|descr= Unregister a loading screen. When none other remains, end the loading.
{{Feature|arma3|The loading screen can be force-ended with the {{Link|Arma 3: Cheats#ENDLOAD|ENDLOAD cheat code}}.}}

|s1= screenId call [[BIS_fnc_endLoadingScreen]]

|p1= screenId: [[String]] - screen ID, used in [[BIS_fnc_startLoadingScreen]]

|r1= [[Boolean]] - true when unregistered

|x1= <sqf>["myLoadingScreen", "Loading… wait for my splendid™ mission!"] call BIS_fnc_startLoadingScreen;
uiSleep 3;
"myLoadingScreen" call BIS_fnc_endLoadingScreen;</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_startLoadingScreen]] [[startLoadingScreen]] [[endLoadingScreen]]
}}
